page_note: The page divides clearly: segments 0-17 are hortatory/ecclesial application (consequences of failing to establish the Five Vigils — master, teacher, Church, brethren, apostle who sent him), culminating in the explicit "I have taught you" marker at seg 17. Segments 18-31 then turn to a substantive cosmological correspondence — Zone, encampments of great gods, Watchers not manifest, gods contracted against matter — mapped onto the Mind of Light in the body. The cosmic side maps cosmos→cosmos (Watchers ↔ Mind of Light) and constitutes genuine substrate teaching. Heavy lacunae throughout (~70% damage). Editorial fatigue score is negative (substrate increases in second half), consistent with hortatory frame opening transitioning into substrate analogy.
